events.title: Former Walgreens CEO Roz Brewer: Don't 'AI proof' higher education, embrace it
events.body: The former Walgreens chief is fast-tracking a technology roadmap to modernize Spelman College amid shifting federal funding priorities.

events.title: Starbucks CEO gets roasted for $9 ‘premium experience’ remarks, but Wall Street toasts his tariff-era turnaround strateg
events.body: Brian Niccol pitched a $9 cup of coffee as an affordable luxury that people don't mind "splurging" on. The internet didn't agree.
